name: El Salvador
description: El Salvador from Joya de Cerén and the Pipil to independence, coffee, the massacre of 1932, the civil war and Bukele.

checkpoints.name: The Maya and the Pipil
checkpoints.note: Maya towns such as Joya de Cerén and Tazumal, and later the Pipil people, lived in the volcanic valleys.

checkpoints.name: Spanish rule
checkpoints.note: Spain founded San Salvador in 1525 and ruled the land from Guatemala.

checkpoints.name: Coffee republic
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1821. Coffee made a few families rich, and the rising of 1932 ended in a massacre.

checkpoints.name: War and after
checkpoints.note: Civil war from 1979 to 1992 killed some 75,000. Gangs grew after the war, and Bukele's crackdown since 2022 has changed the country.
